zh: 我居然忘记了今天有课！

en: I know that some of your students don't like you.
zh: 我知道你的一些学生不喜欢你。

en: He brought me to school in a car.
He majored in literature at the university.
I haven't decided whether to study at university or to get a job.
zh: 去读大学还是去上班，我还没决定。

en: The students are in the classroom.
I don't want to learn your language.
All the students passed the test.
zh: 全部的学生们都考试及格了。

en: Do you guys go to the same school?
One of your teachers called to say you weren't in school today.
zh: 你的一位老师打电话我告诉你今天没上学。

en: The teacher should be very patient with her students.
zh: 老师应该对学生非常耐心。

en: My sister is a teacher.
Our class has more than twenty students.
zh: 我们班有二十多个学生。

en: Our class has more than ten students.
How many professors are there at the University of Turku?
zh: 图尔库大学有多少位教授？

en: How did you learn to speak?
Tom often walks to school.
I couldn't go to school for a whole week.
zh: 我一整周都不能去学校了。

en: Is there a quiet corner in here where I can study?
zh: 这儿有没有比较安静的地方我可以学习的？

en: I have a separate notebook for each class.
zh: 每堂课我都分别有一本笔记。

en: It is easier to study when you are sitting in a comfortable chair.
zh: 当你坐在一把舒适的椅子上的时候，更容易学习。

en: Good luck on your test.
She tattled on me to her teacher.
zh: 她向她的老师打我小报告。

en: Did you pass your exams?
The school rules that students cannot smoke.
zh: 学校规定学生不能抽烟。

en: I thought you said you wouldn't be coming to school today.
zh: 我以为你说了今天不上学了。

en: There are one hundred people in my school.
zh: 我的学校里有一百个人。

en: Isn't he a graduate student at the University of Rome?
zh: 他不是罗马大学的研究生吗?

en: Is it difficult to learn Chinese?
zh: 学习 汉语 难 不 难?

en: Do you have friends in your class?
We must learn to accept the people around us.
Tom has to do better on the next test or he'll fail my class.
zh: 汤姆在下次考试需要考好，或者他将失败我的课。

en: Many schools are closed today because of the storm.
zh: 今天许多学校因为风暴停课。

en: Tom is a very patient teacher.
zh: 湯姆是一位非常有耐心的老師。

en: How far is it to this university?
I gave all of the Chinese proverbs back to the teacher.
zh: 我把成语全部还给老师了。

en: I have to take a test tomorrow.
Tom told me that he won't come to school tomorrow.
zh: 汤姆告诉我他明天不来上学。

en: Only sixteen percent of the teachers at the school are female.
zh: 这所学校的老师只有百分之十六是女性。

en: I feel a yearning for the university.
zh: 我对于上大学有一种渴望。

en: Tom will graduate in October.
Tom was at school all day.
My brother and I are in the same class.
zh: 我的兄弟和我在一个班级。

en: I've got a lot more to learn.
Tom is the reason I became a teacher.
zh: 湯姆是我成為教師的原因。

en: You have to know Russian to learn this language.
zh: 你得了解俄语才能学这门语言。

en: Tom didn't have enough time to answer all the questions on the test.
zh: 汤姆考试时没时间答完所有题。

en: Was the teacher young?
Tom didn't know that I was a French teacher.
zh: 湯姆並不知道我是法文老師。

en: Tom needs to learn to think for himself.
zh: Tom 需要学会为自己着想。

en: The exam was relatively easy.
Never live in the past but always learn from it.
zh: 不要沉迷于过去，而是要从中吸取教训。

en: The teacher began to ask us questions.
Tom was the only boy in the entire class.
zh: 汤姆是班里唯一的男生。

en: I was the last one to turn in my test.
Did Tom tell you why he wasn't at school yesterday?
zh: 汤姆告诉你他昨天为什么不去学校了吗？

en: The teachers knew about it.
I want to enroll at graduate school.
Today I had four exams.
Sami's bedroom could fit his entire school.
zh: 萨米的卧室大到能开一所学校。

en: She said that she was a new student.
I knew Tom was a bad student. I just didn't know how bad.
zh: 我知道了汤姆是个坏学生，可我仅仅不知道他是这么坏的。

en: I have four lessons today.
My school library has a collection of 2.5 million books.
zh: 我校图书馆藏书二百五十万册。

en: We study English, since it is an important subject nowadays.
zh: 我们学习英语，就今天来说是一项重要科目。

en: My sister is 20 years old. She is a university student.
zh: 我妹妹二十岁。她是大学生。

en: Let's go back to lesson three.
All of the children are listening to the teacher's words.
zh: 所有小孩都听老师的话。

en: My class is not very big; there are only 11 students.
zh: 我的班不大,只有十一个学生.

en: I have passed all my exams.
I was forced to learn Spanish.
She doesn't like to go to school.
At that time, I was still taking French lessons.
zh: 那个时候，我还在上法语课。

en: My husband is a teacher, too.
Can you recommend a good French teacher?
zh: 你可以介绍好的法语老师吗？

en: Tom forgot to write his name on the test paper.
zh: 汤姆忘了在测卷上写名字。

en: He's a very good teacher, isn't he?
zh: 他是一名很好的老师，对吗？

en: I hope that Tom has learned his lesson.
zh: 我希望汤姆已经吸取教训了。

en: I wonder where Tom is planning to go to college.
zh: 我想知道汤姆计划去哪里上大学。

en: French is so difficult that I don't want to learn it any more.
The school's tallest structure is that water tower.
zh: 学校最高的建筑就是那个水塔。

en: I am going to have a Chinese lesson.
My dream is to study Russian in Moscow.
zh: 我的梦想是在莫斯科里学习俄语。

en: Do you have lessons at night?
This is a very good way to learn languages.
zh: 这是学习语言的好方法。

en: All the teachers were in the pub.
I still have lessons in French and Dutch to take.
zh: 我还有法语课和荷兰语课要上。

en: When she was in elementary school, the teacher often scolded her.
zh: 在小学的时候，她常常被老师骂。

en: Latin is not at all easy to learn.
Tomorrow is the exam. Are you all prepared?
zh: 明天就要考试啦，大家准备好了没呀？

en: Greek is hard to learn.
Hello everyone! I am your Chinese teacher.
zh: 大家好！我是你们的汉语老师。

en: The teacher requested to see one of my parents.
Can you please properly study a foreign language?
Do you speak the Shanghai dialect at school?
zh: 你在学校里说上海话吗？

en: Teachers nowadays are super into testing. It seems that there's another test today.
zh: 现在的老师么，非常迷信考试，据说今天又要考试啦。

en: I'm learning to drive at a driving school.
I want to learn Japanese but I don't like watching anime.
zh: 我想学日语，但是我不喜欢看日本动画片。

en: The class has started. Please take your seats.
We have an important exam next week.
zh: 我们下周有一场重要的考试。

en: The number of students grows year by year.
zh: 学生人数一年比一年增加。

en: Yesterday I was late for school.
Nearly half the students have learned English.
zh: 差不多一半同学都学过英语。

en: There are many foreigners that come to Japan to learn Japanese.
zh: 为了学习日语而来日本的外国人很多。

en: School has already started for them.
He ended up taking the test.
Mary said she didn't learn anything new at school today.
zh: 玛丽说今天在学校没有学新的东西。

en: She started talking about the school's secrets again.
zh: 她又开始讲起了学校的秘密。

en: My friend explained the way to learn foreign languages in detail.
zh: 朋友向我详细说明了外语的学习方法。

en: Life without love is just totally pointless.
zh: 没有爱情的生活毫无意义。

en: I don't know what to say to make you feel better.
zh: 我不知道该说什么来安慰你。

en: People who love doubt nothing, or doubt everything.
zh: 喜欢的人什么都不怀疑，或什么都疑神疑鬼。

en: You are very fortunate that you have such friends.
zh: 你们很幸运有这样的朋友们。

en: I don't care as long as you are happy.
How can I feel relaxed, with you watching me like that?
zh: 你那么看着我，我哪里放松得下来啊？

en: Sorry, but can you show me the way to the next village?
zh: 能不能麻烦你告诉我去邻村怎么走？

en: When he feels fine, he goes for a walk.
I'm very sorry I came home so late.
My happy schooldays will soon be behind me.
zh: 我快乐的校园时光，很快就要离我而去了。

en: Happy are those who love flowers.
Those who forget everything are happy.
I'm sorry for your not having come with us.
zh: 我很遗憾您没有和我们一起来。

en: I'm sorry, but it's just not possible.
zh: 我很抱歉, 但它就是不可能的。

en: Love is seeing her in your dreams.
zh: 爱便是在你的梦中梦见她。

en: To love and to be loved is the greatest happiness.
zh: 爱和被爱是最大的幸福。

en: All right! You will be sorry for this.
Mary and I became good friends.
A friend in need is a friend indeed.
zh: 不能共患難的人, 不是真正的朋友

en: Mike has a few friends in Florida.
zh: 麥克在佛羅里達州有一些朋友。

en: Bob is my friend.
Bob was very happy.
Frank was waiting with pleasure for the date in the evening.
zh: 法兰克高兴地等待着他晚上的约会。

en: Bill has many friends.
The party was put off for a week.
I'm very happy to hear about the party.
zh: 我听到聚会的事很高兴。

en: Thank you for inviting me to the party.
zh: 感谢你请我来参加派对。

en: Tom married an older girl.
zh: 汤姆娶了一个比他大的女孩。

en: Tom is a friend of mine.
zh: 湯姆是我朋友中的其中一位。

en: I feel very cold.
I've got my friend on the line right now.
zh: 我正在和朋友打电话呢。

en: Tatsuya has some friends who live in New York.
zh: 達也有一些朋友住在紐約。

en: It is not because I hate him, but because I love him.
zh: 这并不是因为我恨他，相反我爱他。

en: He was happy to have passed the examination.
zh: 他为考试及格感到高兴。

en: The party has been put off until next Tuesday.
zh: 聚会已经推迟到了下周二。

en: I met a friend there.
zh: 我在那里碰见一个朋友。

en: I am sorry to trouble you.
zh: 我很抱歉給你添麻煩了。

en: Are you married or are you single?
I guess I'm never going to get married.
Sorry, I've got to go.
zh: 不好意思，我必須要走了。

en: Happy birthday to you!
Mr. Brown, a friend from Oregon, will visit us tomorrow.
zh: 一个从俄勒冈州来的朋友，布朗先生明天会来拜访我们。

en: If she had married you, she would be happy now.
zh: 如果她和你结婚了，她现在会很幸福。

en: There appears to be a party in that house.
zh: 这房子里似乎在办派对。

en: I was born to love you.
zh: 我生来就是为了爱你的。

en: I'm sorry I've kept you waiting so long.
zh: 让您等了很久，我很抱歉。

en: There is no reason for you to feel inferior to anyone.
zh: 你没理由觉得自己比别人差的。

en: You will be sorry for it some day.
zh: 有一天这会让你遗憾的。

en: I'll be very happy if I can serve you.
zh: 能为你服务我会感到非常高兴。

en: She said that she was happy.
Happy is the man who is contented.
I'm not in the least bit happy now.
I don't feel like eating anything now.
zh: 我现在不想吃任何东西。

en: I don't feel like eating anything today.
I will put up at my friend's tonight.
zh: 今晚我将在朋友家过夜。

en: She dreamed a happy dream last night.
The man who I thought was my friend deceived me.
zh: 被我认作朋友的那个男人欺骗了我。

en: It is already ten years since we got married.
zh: 我们结婚已经有十年了。

en: I have no friend with whom to talk about it.
zh: 我没有任何可以谈这件事的朋友。

en: Some of my friends can speak English well.
zh: 我的一些朋友英语说得很好。

en: I asked twenty people to my party but not all of them came.
zh: 我邀请了二十人参加我们的聚会，但不是所有人都来。

en: I never have an ice cream without feeling happy.
I love watching soccer games.
I met a Smith at the party.
zh: 我在聚会上见了史密斯。

en: I will not attend the party.
I'm not going to go to the party.
I love watching basketball.
After I got married, my Japanese got better and I could understand more.
zh: 在我结婚之后，我的日语水平提高了，能理解更多日语了。

en: I don't feel like going out right now.
I was happy yesterday.
I had an umbrella with me but my friend did not.
zh: 我带了一把雨伞但是我朋友没有带。

en: I'm not sure of the exact date.
I don't know when she got married.
zh: 我不知道她是什么时候结婚的。

en: I was moved by her love for other people.
zh: 我被她对别人的爱心所感动。

en: I want to pick out a present for my friend.
zh: 我想给我朋友选个礼物。

en: We are sorry we can't help you.
zh: 我们很遗憾没能帮助你们。

en: We are to be married next Sunday.
When poverty comes in at the door, love flies out the window.
zh: 当贫穷降临在门口，爱从窗外飞走。

en: I met an old friend of mine the other day.
zh: 我那天碰到了我其中的一个老朋友。

en: I was happy to see him.
He is married to an American lady.
zh: 他和一个美国女人结婚了。

en: He's always looking at you. He must love you.
zh: 他整天盯著你看，肯定是喜歡你了。

en: He once knew her, but they are no longer friends.
zh: 他过去认识她，但他们现在不再是朋友了。

en: He quickly made friends with the new boy on the block.
zh: 他很快便与小区里新来的男孩交上了朋友。

en: He finally decided to get married.
He seems quite happy.
He explained to Mary why he was late for her birthday party.
zh: 他向玛丽解释自己为什么会在她的生日聚会上迟到。

en: He shared his box of biscuits with all his friends.
zh: 他和他所有的朋友分享了他的那盒饼干。

en: He could not forsake his friend in trouble.
zh: 他不会抛下落难的朋友不管。

en: He is an old friend of mine.
He saved his friend at the risk of his own life.
zh: 他冒著生命危險救了他的朋友。

en: He grieved at the death of his best friend.
zh: 他为他最要好的朋友的死感到悲伤。

en: He has an innate love of adventure.
He tried to kill himself because he lost her love.
zh: 他失戀了，所以便嘗試自殺。

en: He betrayed her secret to his friends.
zh: 他把她的秘密告诉了他的朋友。

en: He was laughed at by his friends.
He was looked up to by all his friends.
I know they're in love with each other.
They have been married for four years.
They lived a happy life.
She doesn't have any friends or relatives to take care of her.
zh: 她没有任何亲戚朋友照顾她。

en: She has very few close friends.
I was happy to see her again.
zh: 我很高兴再次见到了她。

en: He was happy at the news of her success.
zh: 听到她成功的消息，他很高兴。

en: She got married at the age of seventeen.
She got married at the age of 25.
When did she get married?
She loves chocolate, too.
She married him last year.
She has many friends in Hong Kong.
She has a great love for antique goods.
She didn't show up at the party yesterday.
zh: 昨天的派对上她并没有如约而至。

en: She's loved by her friends.
She is more of an acquaintance than a friend.
zh: 与其说她是我的朋友，不如说她只是一个我认识的人。

en: I hear she is going to get married next month.
zh: 我听说，她下个月结婚了。

en: I really like him, but not his circle of friends.
zh: 我真的很喜歡他, 可是我不喜歡他周圍的朋友。

en: I wish I'd married another man.
zh: 我要是嫁给别人就好了。

en: Maternal love is greater than anything else.
zh: 母爱比任何别的东西都伟大。

en: All of my friends like soccer.
zh: 我所有的朋友都喜歡足球。

en: You should choose your friends very carefully.
Sorry to trouble you.
He is my friend. Do you guys know him?
zh: 他是我的朋友。你们认识吗？

en: So sorry to keep you waiting so long.
Love is giving something one doesn't have.
zh: 爱情是给予一个人所没有的东西。

en: She became a true friend of mine.
zh: 她成為我的一位真正的朋友。

en: Our friend finished the race in second place.
zh: 我们的朋友完成了比赛，得了第二名。

en: Why say sorry for something you haven't even done?
zh: 为什么你要对你没做过的事表示抱歉？

en: Where's your date tonight?
zh: 今天晚上你在什么地方有约会？

en: Like me, Lucy has many friends.
zh: 露西和我一样有很多朋友。

en: Some Shanghainese hold large banquets when they get married.
zh: 上海人结婚，有的人家办酒宴场面很大。

en: She has few friends.
Plato is my friend, but the truth is worth more to me.
zh: 柏拉图是我的朋友，但于我，真理比这更重要。

en: He doesn't have any friends to play with.
Ann has many friends.
I didn't really feel like going out.
No one can have three different birth dates.
zh: 三个不同的出生日期谁也不可能有。

en: You don't know how much I love you.
Love if you want to be loved!
She got all dolled up for her big date.
zh: 为了她的重要约会，她精心打扮了一下。

en: I got married ten years ago.
A female friend of mine loves to go to gay bars with me.
zh: 我的一个女性朋友喜欢跟我一起去同志酒吧。

en: My friend asked me if I was feeling all right.
zh: 我朋友问我是不是觉得还好。

en: Sorry, I was dining and I didn't see the message.
zh: 抱歉，我刚才在吃饭，没有看到信息。

en: Thanks for adding me as a friend.
What is your date of birth?
I often go out with friends in the evening.
zh: 我常常在晚上跟朋友出去玩儿。

en: You don't need millions to be happy.
zh: 快乐不需要数百万的钱。

en: I married when I was 19 years old.
What has your friend been doing recently?
zh: 你的朋友近来在忙些什么？

en: As she's a very practical person, she often fixes her friends' cars.
zh: 她作为一个喜欢动手实践的人常常把朋友的汽车修好。

en: I'd love to find out why she said so.
zh: 我很想找出她为什么这么说的原因。

en: When I'm feeling low, I talk with friends or go out for a walk.
zh: 觉得难过的时候，我会跟朋友谈心或出去散步。

en: Sorry, you have the wrong number.
He's an old friend of mine.
I wish you a happy birthday.
I am very, very sorry.
Other requirements come from your relationships with other people and your daily activities.
zh: 其它的要素来自你跟别人的关系和你平日的活动。

en: Would you ever consider dating your best friend's ex-boyfriend?
zh: 你有没有想过跟朋友的前男友约会？

en: Tom says that he doesn't feel like going out.
Tom is able to come to our party tomorrow.
zh: 汤姆明天能来我们的聚会。

en: Tom has many friends living in Boston.
zh: 湯姆有很多朋友住在波士頓。

en: Tom said that he felt sorry for Mary.
Tom doesn't know whether Mary is happy or not.
zh: 汤姆不知道玛丽是高兴呢，还是不高兴。

en: Tom died in the evening of the day he and Mary got married.
zh: 汤姆死在了他和玛丽结婚的那天傍晚。

en: Tom became friends with Mary.
I'm sorry, I have to respond to the messages.
zh: 不好意思，我必须回复短信。

en: Only if you come will she come to my birthday party.
zh: 只有你来了，她才会来我的生日派对。

en: I was really very happy.
I am sorry. I am not from here.
I feel like the window was open all night.
zh: 我感觉窗子一整晚都开着。

en: Tom has many friends.
Sorry, what's your name?
zh: 不好意思，你叫什么名字？

en: I waited for my friend for an hour.
zh: 我等我的一个朋友等了一小时。

en: I married eight years ago.
Oh, I'm really sorry.
Love is not just a feeling, but also an art.
zh: 所谓爱，并不仅仅是一种情感，也是一种艺术。

en: I heard you are going to get married.
I was unable to go to his birthday party.
zh: 我那时没法去他的生日派对。

en: My friend was shot.
I feel smart... Pity... It's just a feeling...
zh: 我感觉自己很聪明。。。可惜。。。这只是个感觉。。。

en: He has been secretly in love with her.
Do you know how my friends describe me?
zh: 你知道我朋友怎么形容我？

en: He got married quickly.
Quite a lot of friends and acquaintances have come.
You have nothing to be sorry about.
They want to get married.
He eventually married an Italian woman ten years his junior.
zh: 他最终和一个比他小十岁的意大利女人结了婚。

en: She has no real friends.
Mary has many friends.
I really am sorry.
I know Tom was your best friend.
zh: 我知道汤姆曾是你最好的朋友。

en: I used to have a friend named Tom.
I do love Finland, but I can't stand the Finns.
zh: 我喜歡芬蘭，但我受不了芬蘭人。

en: I'd like us to be friends again.
zh: 我希望我们能重新做朋友。

en: I don't want to go to Tom's birthday party.
Are you saying you don't want to go to Tom's party?

zh: 她的作品給我留下了深刻印象。

en: Whether he studies or goes into business, I won't stop him.
zh: 不管他是上学还是做生意，我不会反对。

en: I want to see your boss.
This company achieved a remarkable increase in turnover last year.
zh: 这家公司去年获得显著的营业额增长。

en: Does your salary get put on your pay card on a monthly basis?
zh: 您的工资是每个月打入您的工资卡吗？

en: I've been in this business a long time.
zh: 我干这一行已经很久了。

en: I like being my own boss.
I guess my job is pretty undramatic.
zh: 我觉得我的工作太平淡无奇了。

en: I'm afraid I wouldn't be very good company.
zh: 我恐怕不是个很好的伙伴。

en: I'm still the boss here.
The boss is there?
My boss wants us to take the plane.
zh: 我的老板要我们搭（那个）飞机。

en: My boss just fired me.
zh: 我的老板刚刚解雇了我。

en: Judging from the current situation, this project is sure to succeed.
zh: 根据当前的状况，这个项目绝对会成功。

en: My salary is 300,000 yen.
I'm glad we hired you for this job.
zh: 我很高兴我们录用了你来担任这份工作。

en: I intend to see the project through.
What did you tell your boss?
zh: 你跟你的老板说什么了？

en: I want to talk to your boss.
His boss is friendly, he's American.
zh: 他的老板是个很友好的美国人。

en: I'm getting too old for this job.
zh: 对于这份工作来说，我的年龄太老了。

en: Does Tom know you work here?
zh: 汤姆知道你在这里工作吗？

en: He encountered difficulties in his work.
zh: 他在工作上遇到了麻烦。

en: Don't sign the contract in pencil.
I am the boss in my office.
zh: 我是我们办公室的头儿。

en: This meeting isn't over.
You don't deserve the salary they're paying you.
zh: 你不应该得到他们给你的薪水。

en: I'm not the boss.
This could hurt our business.
I've had a lot of work to do lately.
zh: 我最近有很多事情要做。

en: He works for a newspaper with a large circulation.
zh: 他为一份印刷量很大的报纸工作。

en: Tom translated a letter from French to English for his boss.
zh: 汤姆为他的老板把一封信从法语翻译成了英语。

en: He is too young to undertake this work.
zh: 他太年轻，无法胜任这项工作。

en: I am writing my internship report.
Does Tom have a job?
Tom can't work this evening.
Tom began to work before sunrise.
zh: 汤姆在日出前开始工作。

en: Does the heating work in the winter?
The supermarket is out of business.
Tom doesn't like to discuss his work.
zh: 汤姆不喜欢谈论他的工作。

en: This isn't a difficult job.
I don't have a car, so I usually go to work by bicycle.
zh: 我没有车，所以我一般骑自行车去上班。

en: Sami was fired from his job for stealing.
zh: 萨米因为偷窃被炒了鱿鱼。

en: Don't flirt with the customers.
Sami became more aggressive with customers.
zh: 萨米对顾客变得更加挑衅了。

en: This damn computer doesn't work.
I can't work for this company anymore.
zh: 我没法再在这家公司里面工作了。

en: This work is not suited to young girls.
zh: 这个工作不适合年轻女孩。

en: Does Tom work in the kitchen?
Tom's boss was really angry.
zh: 汤姆的上司真的非常生气。

en: What company does he work in?
Tom works as an elephant trainer in a circus.
zh: 汤姆在一个马戏团当训象师。

en: There has been a lot of stress at work lately.
I'm getting nowhere with you! Call the manager!
zh: 和你讲这些没用！让店长出来！

en: A complicated job like that can't be done in the blink of an eye.
zh: 如此复杂的工作决不能毕其功于一役。

en: You can't avoid office politics.
This area is famous for its handcraft business.
zh: 该地区因它的手工业而出名。

en: Pushing customers to complete a task can be a headache.
zh: 催促客户去完成一件任务是很让人头疼的事。

en: Jack was really disappointed, and left his job.
My colleague arranged the work files for me.
zh: 同事为我准备好了工作文件。

en: The person who gets the highest salary at the company does the least work.
zh: 公司里工资最高的人，只用干最少的活。

en: This contract is made in duplicate.
